🚨 China faces a COVID-like crisis with a mysterious virus called Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV). Hospitals are overcrowded, and HMPV emerges as a key threat. Spreading via droplets and close contact, the virus is adding to a wave of respiratory infections.

nodes.text: China battles a surge of respiratory infections as HMPV emerges as a serious threat. Overcrowded hospitals and rising cases echo familiar fears. Stay informed, stay safe. 🛡️ #ChinaCrisis #HMPV #HealthAlert https://t.co/2CI9lL5XzZ
